vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: wechat-mp-fetch
Version: 1.0.1

The skill bundle is a legitimate tool for fetching WeChat Official Account articles using Playwright. The script `scripts/wx-article-fetch.js` correctly validates the input URL, uses a headless browser to extract content from the standard `#js_content` selector, and returns the data in JSON format. No malicious behaviors such as data exfiltration, unauthorized network access, or obfuscation were detected.

llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and dependencies are coherent with its stated purpose (fetching WeChat MP articles via a headless Playwright browser); it does not request extra credentials or hidden endpoints, but running arbitrary web content in a local headless browser and installing Playwright has the usual operational risks users should consider.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the implementation: the skill uses Playwright to load mp.weixin.qq.com pages and extract title/content. Declared dependencies (playwright, Node.js) are appropriate and necessary for this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the script limit actions to navigating to the provided URL, waiting for rendering, extracting #js_content and title, and printing JSON. They do not read other files, environment variables, or transmit results elsewhere. Note: loading arbitrary web pages executes their JavaScript and network requests in the headless browser (expected for this task) which may fetch third-party resources; the skill itself does not appear to exfiltrate data.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No automatic install spec is provided (instruction-only), but package.json/package-lock declare Playwright as a dependency. Playwright and Chromium will be downloaded via npm when the user runs npm install — this is expected but does involve downloading sizable browser binaries from the npm registry/mirror.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests no environment variables, credentials, or config paths. The code does not attempt to access secrets or unrelated services.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is user-invocable and not always-enabled. It does not modify other skills or system agent settings and does not persist data to disk in its implementation (aside from Playwright browser cache/install performed by npm).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims, but review these operational cautions before installing: 1) npm install will download Playwright and Chromium binaries from the npm registry (or mirror) — do this in a controlled environment if you have supply-chain concerns. 2) The headless browser will execute the target page's JavaScript and make network requests when rendering; run the skill on untrusted pages in an isolated container or VM to limit risk from malicious web content. 3) The skill does not handle WeChat login credentials; if you make browser cookies available to access gated content you are responsible for their security. If you want extra assurance, inspect package-lock.json and run the script in a sandboxed environment first.
